precheck.description: check RLS is not already enabled on "outboxMessage"
precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_class" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."relnamespace" WHERE ("n"."nspname" = $1 AND "c"."relname" = $2 AND NOT ("c"."relrowsecurity"))) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "orders"."outboxMessage" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

postcheck.description: verify row-level security is enabled on "outboxMessage"
postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_class" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."relnamespace" WHERE ("n"."nspname" = $1 AND "c"."relname" = $2 AND "c"."relrowsecurity")) AS "result"

precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "outbox_tenant_isolation_c516f4ff" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "outbox_tenant_isolation_c516f4ff" ON "orders"."outboxMessage" AS PERMISSIVE FOR ALL TO PUBLIC USING ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)) WITH CHECK ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true))
